t: Solid Model Generator - public implementations survey
title: Solid Model Generator - public implementations survey
definition: Constructs three-dimensional solid geometry.
description:
Solid Model Generator is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Constructs three-dimensional solid geometry. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Solid Model Generator. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Solid Model Generator. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Solid Model Generator capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.
